title: Pure Crashbug
summary: Crashbug is a Level 3 DARK Fiend Rank 3 Xyz engine played in Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL, consisting of Crashbug X, Crashbug Y, and Crashbug Z, along with their boss Super Crashbug. Each Crashbug summons another from the Deck and swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters when combined with Super Crashbug, turning 0 ATK / 2000 DEF Crashbug X into a 2000 ATK attacker while crippling low-DEF opposing monsters.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Level 3 DARK Fiend starter that Special Summons Crashbug X, Y, or Z directly from the Deck for an instant Rank 3 Xyz.
allow.Fiendish Rhino Warrior: Level 3 Fiend that protects Fiend monsters from destruction and sends a Crashbug to the GY to fuel Super Crashbug.
allow.Shield & Sword: Classic Spell that swaps the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters on the field, turning Crashbug X (2000 DEF) and Super Crashbug (3000 DEF) into massive beatsticks.
allow.Inverse Universe: Normal Trap that permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field.
allow.Number 49: Fortune Tune: Rank 3 Xyz made with Level 3 Crashbugs that gains LP, cannot be targeted or destroyed, and recycles Level 3s from the GY.
allow.Muzurhythm the String Djinn: Rank 3 Fiend Xyz that doubles its ATK to 3000 during battle.
allow.Leviair the Sea Dragon: Rank 3 Xyz that Special Summons a Crashbug X, Y, or Z that was banished to summon Super Crashbug.
allow.Number 34: Terror-Byte: Rank 3 Machine Xyz that steals opponent's lower-level monsters.

main: Level 3 DARK Fiend (0 ATK / 2000 DEF) that Special Summons 1 Crashbug Z from the Deck when Normal Summoned while you control Crashbug Y.
Level 3 DARK Fiend (1400 ATK / 1600 DEF) that Special Summons 1 Crashbug X from the Deck when Normal Summoned while you control Crashbug Z.
Level 3 DARK Fiend (300 ATK / 1500 DEF) that Special Summons 1 Crashbug Y from the Deck when Normal Summoned while you control Crashbug X.
Boss monster (0 ATK / 3000 DEF) that banishes Crashbug X, Y, and Z from the GY to Special Summon itself in Attack Position and swaps the ATK and DEF of all Attack Position monsters on the field.
Summons any Crashbug from the Deck to kickstart Rank 3 plays and load the GY for Super Crashbug.
Dumps the missing Crashbug letter (X, Y, or Z) from the Deck to the GY so Super Crashbug is immediately live.
Archetypal Quick-Play Spell that lets both players Special Summon 1 monster from their hand with the same Level as a face-up monster they control.
Swaps the original ATK and DEF of all monsters on the field until the End Phase, giving Super Crashbug 3000 ATK and Crashbug X 2000 ATK.
Trap that permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field.
extra: Rank 3 Xyz that Special Summons one of the Crashbugs banished by Super Crashbug back to the field.
Rank 3 Xyz made with two Crashbugs that reaches 3000 ATK when attacking.
Rank 3 Xyz that recycles two Level 3 Crashbugs from the GY back to the Deck when sent to the GY.
Rank 3: detaches 1 material to take control of an opponent's Level 4 or lower monster until the End Phase.
